title: Population-response push/fold tables (response) vs the point-aware equilibrium tables (short deck, full 8-player SNGs)
description: Pre-registered in docs/endgame-response-preregistration.md before any validation run. Arm B uses best responses in points to the train-partition population curves; arm A the point-aware equilibrium tables. Both share the base policy and push/fold layer limits; only the tables differ. One of eight co-primary tests (two candidates x two controls x two variants), Holm-corrected at 0.05; min_effect 0: B must beat A with the interval excluding zero. Validation partition; holdout untouched.
